blocking_issues.title: Missing ENVIRONMENTS population breaks MSVR310/RGBNT100 evaluation batches
blocking_issues.detail: entry.configure() replaces run_correspondence_roles._training_batch with incremental.training_batch. The reused _eval_batch dispatches MSVR310 and RGBNT100 to that dynamic global. training_batch indexes ENVIRONMENTS by each raw path basename, but ENVIRONMENTS remains the empty module dictionary because this new entry bypasses incremental.main(), the only population site. The first two RGBNT201 jobs use image_batch and avoid the lookup; the first MSVR310 job then raises KeyError before core.forward_features. Calling the core directly avoids IncrementalObjectiveHeads.forward(return_aux=True), but does not bypass _eval_batch.
blocking_issues.minimal_fix: Copy the existing incremental.main() protocol-record ENVIRONMENTS population loop into the new diagnosis path after read_protocol and before extraction, preserving the scene/camera rule and existing duplicate-key equality assertion. No fallback, no new compatibility layer, no loss/model change.

nonblocking_caveats.detail: Pinned author eval_func_msrv appends re.txt in the current working directory. New children start at ROOT and never change cwd; the two MSVR310 jobs each score four arrays, producing 4728 query blocks in ROOT/re.txt outside the per-job diagnostic folder. This is a concrete inherited output side effect; no supplied artifact evidence shows that ROOT/re.txt is a protected input. Keep it disclosed and do not call the path wholly write-isolated.

This Windows publish checkout is not the exact runnable target tree: 107 old-scope paths are absent and 27 present files differ only by CRLF/LF. The verified 423-file exact execution snapshot is the source authority for this review. Do not deploy the whole Windows tree or claim it is the 420-file physical remote verification. The intended remote pre/post source seal checks remain mandatory.

Remote checkpoint/distance/CLIP bytes were not downloaded or opened. Their hashes are copied from the original physically verified receipts and controls, with exact local text verification. No fresh host/conda/GPU/disk/process check or new diagnosis input seal was available; no neural runtime success or performance/effectiveness claim follows from this source review.

Same-model global is a component diagnosis, correction-only retrieval is normalized solely for diagnosis, and all comparisons remain official post-selection single-seed descriptions. Prior failed RGBNT100 repair_keep and prior FAIL/STOP remain unchanged; no three-dataset/SOTA/novelty or causal-gradient conclusion is established.

verification.name: Checked model construction and strict reload API
verification.detail: The explicit checked build_core/loss_values assignments occur before entry.configure. The repeated configure chain ends with IncrementalObjectiveHeads, DetachedSemanticTriFusion, incremental schema/condition and checked build_core at foundation. The captured original-build functions preserve construction order. All five original initializer bindings exactly equal the original accepted rows; checked entry SHA, objective, head names, cfg YAML, public CLIP, protocol, initial state and two-device placement are present and unchanged. foundation.build compares the entire witness; foundation.load checks schema/dataset/condition/protocol and uses strict=True on the complete state. No model was instantiated by this review.

verification.name: Extraction, eval mode, shapes/devices and no update
verification.detail: AuthorHeadEvidence.train(False) explicitly restores Signal/head eval mode. The extractor uses torch.inference_mode, the existing full ordered eval loaders, no AMP, one core.forward_features call per batch, and four finite CPU FP32 [N,1536] outputs. core.forward_features computes g/c/h/f without the outer auxiliary-head forward. Model state_dict SHA and all grad-is-None checks bracket extraction; no optimizer/save-checkpoint/training call is made. The existing first6 cuda:1 / last6+heads cuda:0 placement is preserved. These properties are subject to fixing B1.

verification.name: Full dataset and same-best metric semantics
verification.detail: Full query/gallery counts are 836/836, 591/1055, 1715/8575, totaling 16926 records over five jobs. Loader paths preserve order without query-identity gallery filtering. Six identity/camera/scene arrays must match both saved distances. MSVR310 same-identity same-scene filtering and other datasets same-identity same-camera filtering are reused. Reused score checks all four upstream metrics; payload epoch/metrics, fused recomputed four metrics and independent global four metrics use <1e-5 points. g/c standalone L2 normalization, h=g+gain*c and f=L2(h) use the original 1e-6 atol/rtol. Paired AP, first-rank repairs/new errors and identity macro AP derive from the same query ordering.

verification.name: Five sequential jobs, thresholds, storage and resource scope
verification.detail: JOBS contains exactly the five qualified endpoints and excludes RGBNT100 repair_keep. One subprocess is waited before the next; first nonzero return stops the queue, with no retry or checkpoint reselection. Coordinator requires physical CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1 and queries index/memory.used only for GPUs0/1. The existing diagnostic free-space threshold is >2147483648 bytes. Expected tensor payload is 624523020 bytes (~0.582 GiB) before serialization/log overhead, consistent with the stated ~0.6 GiB estimate. Original formal storage gate remains 5192548352 bytes. Current conda executable/host/idle process state and the planned observer are operational launch facts, not verified here.

verification.name: Sealing and preservation design
verification.detail: All 423 snapshot entries and 45 primary local files match their supplied digests; all 45 texts equal the original REMOTE.json payload. The qualified source scope has exactly 420 entries, so adding script+plan+review MD+review JSON produces 424; the independent seal must stay outside its own source hash set. require_inputs checks listed source/artifact bytes before and after each job and coordinator completion, plus the original full controller EXIT0. No source/old-result/weight deletion or overwrite appears in the new path. The final diagnosis seal was not supplied, so actual membership/completeness of its five checkpoint/distance/receipt rows, five initializations, three global rows, old45/48 artifact union, CLIP/protocols and 424 sources remains a launch prerequisite, not an attested result.
